mainText:
Good evening. Weather in Prishtina: 9 degrees now, moderate rain. Next 24 hours: high 12, low 6.

Albania moved into a 1-0 lead against Belarus in the Euro 2028 play-off first leg, putting them just 45 minutes away from qualifying. Striker Rei Manaj scored after a defensive error, while Qazim Laçi missed a golden chance.

Interior Minister Xhelal Sveçla welcomed an anti-drug operation that resulted in the arrest of six suspects, including former culture minister Astrit Haraqija, on trafficking charges.

Elon Musk has signed a petition demanding the reinstatement of Nvidia co-founder Jensen Huang as chief executive after Huang's unexpected resignation.

Professor Abit Hoxha said the main diplomatic front for the Kosovo Liberation Army leaders' appeal at the Hague is now in Brussels, and he expects limited progress in the legal arena.

Former prime minister Pandeli Majko urged the National Assembly to expel a thousand party members he claims have ties to organized crime, calling for a clean-up of the Socialist Party.
